name: ingenidev Gift Unlocker for woocommerce
author: ingenidev by Bright Vortex LLC

sections.description:
ingenidev Gift Unlocker is a comprehensive WooCommerce extension that enables store owners to create engaging promotional campaigns by offering free gift products based on cart total thresholds. This plugin helps increase average order value and customer engagement through strategic gift offerings.

Features

  • Gift Product Management – Define unlimited gift products with custom thresholds
  • Smart Threshold System – Multiple cart total thresholds with dynamic gift availability
  • Advanced Restrictions – One gift type per cart policy with maximum quantity enforcement
  • Enhanced User Experience – Custom “Get X for FREE” buttons with real-time updates
  • Performance & Security – AJAX-powered updates with WordPress nonce security validation
  • WooCommerce Integration – Seamlessly integrates with your existing WooCommerce store

Perfect For

  • Promotional campaigns
  • Increasing average order value
  • Customer engagement and loyalty programs
  • Seasonal sales and special offers
  • Product launches and marketing initiatives

How It Works

  1. Configure gift products with minimum cart total thresholds
  2. Customers add items to their cart
  3. When the cart total reaches a threshold, a gift becomes available
  4. Customers can select one free gift per order
  5. Gift is automatically added to cart at zero cost

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Support

For support and feature requests, please visit https://ingenidev.com

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data. It only manages gift product configurations and interacts with WooCommerce cart data.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “ingenidev Gift Unlocker for woocommerce”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Extract the zip file
  3. Upload the ingenidev_gift_unlocker_for_woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

After Activation

  1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active
  2. Navigate to Ingenidev > Gift Unlocker in your WordPress admin
  3. Add your gift products with their threshold settings
  4. Configure display options as needed
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Can I set different thresholds for different products?

Yes, each gift product can have its own minimum cart total threshold.

How many gifts can a customer select?

Customers can select one gift per order. The plugin enforces a one-gift-per-cart policy.

What happens if the cart total drops below the threshold?

The gift is automatically removed from the cart if the total drops below the required threshold.

Can I limit the quantity of each gift?

Yes, you can set a maximum quantity for each gift product to prevent abuse.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully internationalized and ready for translation.

Does it work with variable products?

The plugin is designed to work with all WooCommerce product types.

Can I customize the gift button appearance?

The buttons use standard WooCommerce styling and can be customized with CSS.
